  PROBLEM: The completion logic treats every orchestrator-managed child PR merge as a real completion, regardless of its target branch.
  WHY: This can label issues `ai:merged` and finalize their lineage when the child PR was not merged into its integration branch.

  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]

  WHY: A managed child merged into another non-default branch can still be labelled, closed, and added to the lineage-finalization list.

  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]

  WHY: `tests-heal-plan-and-validation` fails on the PR merge ref, leaving CI red; the test and workflow are outside the PR’s changed-file list.

- requirement: Apply the merged label and finalize lineage for an orchestrator-managed child only when it is merged into its integration branch.
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml, the completion gate logic
  confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The completion gate treats any orchestrator-managed child merge as a completion regardless of the merge target branch; The condition accepts a managed child regardless of where the PR merged. A managed child whose PR merges into a non-default, non-integration branch (for example a `claude/implement-plan-*` branch that is not its `orchestrator/project-N` integration) is still added to `LINEAGE_FINALIZE_ISSUE_NUMBERS`, labelled `ai:merged`, and closed.; The condition at line 472 accepts every issue classified as managed, regardless of `PR_BASE_REF`. It does not verify that the PR target is that child’s integration branch, so a managed child merged into another non-default branch is still labelled, closed, and added to the lineage-finalization list.

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- .github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml:462 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The completion logic incorrectly marks every orchestrator-managed child PR merge as a "real completion".
  WHY: The condition `|| [ "${is_managed_child}" = "true" ]` sets `issue_is_completion=true` regardless of the target branch. This causes issues to be labeled `ai:merged` and their lineage finalized even when the child PR is merged into a non-integration branch, violating the requirement that finalization occurs only for merges into *its* integration branch.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: Apply the merged label and finalize lineage for an orchestrator-managed child only when it is merged into its integration branch.
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml, the completion gate logic.
  Evidence of absence: The completion gate treats any orchestrator-managed child merge as a completion regardless of the merge target branch, while the requirement explicitly restricts this to its integration branch.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:2071 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The fragment-rejection only fires when a `#` immediately follows the issue number. A URL of the form `https://github.com/o/r/issues/9?view=plain#issuecomment-1` still matches because `?` is in the new boundary set — only `#` was added to the exclusion.
  WHY: on a default-branch merge, the body/title fallback extracts issue 9 from such a URL; the issue is then labelled `ai:merged` and closed, which is exactly the mislabel the issue is meant to prevent. The same body/title path is also reused by review_autofix, so the wrong issue would also be linked there.
- .github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml:450-499 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: A tracking issue whose label lookup fails is treated like a real tracking issue and bypasses the completion check, so its lineage is not finalized.
  WHY: if GraphQL classify fails for an ordinary issue whose PR is a real completion, the issue is still labelled and closed but its lineage is never finalized. This is the existing fail-open posture, but the diff makes lineage finalization strictly dependent on label-fetch success where it was not before. No new test pins this; no agents.md or changelog note documents it.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "Apply FINAL_LABEL (ai:merged) and finalize lineage only for a real completion" — with completion defined as a default-branch merge, an unmerged close, or "an orchestrator-managed child merged into its integration branch (is_managed_child, which already closes on integration merges and must keep doing so)".
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml, the completion-condition test (after the autofix: `[ "${PR_MERGED}" != "true" ] || [ "${PR_BASE_REF}" = "${REPO_DEFAULT_BRANCH}" ] || [ "${is_managed_child}" = "true" ]`).
  Evidence of absence: The condition accepts a managed child regardless of where the PR merged. A managed child whose PR merges into a non-default, non-integration branch (for example a `claude/implement-plan-*` branch that is not its `orchestrator/project-N` integration) is still added to `LINEAGE_FINALIZE_ISSUE_NUMBERS`, labelled `ai:merged`, and closed.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 2
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
